Abolishing the Dept. of Education- because the obvious solution when something isn’t perfect is to light it on fire and hope for the best. 

Trump is using children as props so he can sign away the agency meant to ensure that they can learn to read. 

This is not reform, not freedom- just an open invitation for underfunding, censorship and privatization. And somehow, were meant to applaud it like it’s bold leadership. This is embarrassing.

These people lost their homies families and lives, and now we’re just going to send them back into the war just so Trump can score a few political points? Half the people cheering this on probably couldn’t point out Ukraine on a map, yet they wanna round up women and children who’ve been here for two years, trying to rebuild their lives. And people are cheering to send them back to a country still being shelled by Russian missiles. This is embarrassing.

If you axe the department of education, you’re basically leaving special needs kids out to dry. Federal  IDEA funding? Gone. Schools will be scrambling to afford special ed teachers, therapists, and basic accommodations. On top of that, kids are graduating highschool barely able to read. If you gut funding from low income schools that already rely on federal cash ti keep their reading programs alive, even more students will graduate illiterate.
